canonical_name: gzip 1.2.4 (1993) -- GNU zip: DEFLATE (LZ77 + Huffman), the redesign forced by the LZW patent
lineage: Compression lineage, the HISTORICAL REDESIGN under legal pressure: Unisys's enforcement of the LZW patent (1993-94) made compress unshippable for GNU; Jean-loup Gailly's gzip (1992-93) used Ziv-Lempel 1977 plus Huffman -- DEFLATE, later RFC 1951 and zlib's core -- and replaced compress across Unix. 1.2.4 (Aug 1993) is the version that stayed frozen for a decade. Beside the vault's zlib-1.3.1 (the library form, 2024) and compress/ncompress, this closes the compress -> gzip -> zlib series.
entry_points: gzip / gunzip / zcat; deflate.c (LZ77 hashing), trees.c (Huffman), inflate.c

example.command: ./configure && make; ./gzip -c sample > s.gz; ./gzip -dc s.gz | cmp - sample
example.output: round trip exact; ratio versus compact and compress on the same input

upstream_docs: Deutsch, DEFLATE Compressed Data Format Specification, RFC 1951 (1996)
Ziv & Lempel, A Universal Algorithm for Sequential Data Compression, IEEE IT 1977

human_capability_summary.built_to: compress files better than compress without infringing the LZW patent, and interoperate forever via a fixed format
human_capability_summary.pressure: the Unisys LZW patent (legal), disk/bandwidth scarcity, portability across 1993 Unixes and DOS
human_capability_summary.success_means: exact round trip, better ratio than compress, patent-free

human_failure_condition: a format change would orphan every archive; a patent claim would stop distribution
behavioral_entry_point: vary -1..-9 (the lazy-match effort knob in deflate.c) and record ratio/time; compare with compact and ncompress on one corpus

lineage_relations.note: gzip displaced compress under patent pressure (direction: gzip superseded compress)
same author (Gailly) and algorithm; the library form

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run gzip-1.2.4-1993
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: compress files better than compress without infringing the LZW patent, and interoperate forever via a fixed format
